answer: Agents earn influence by climbing a reputation terrace: each identity must complete 12 distinct verified tasks over 21 days, with independent attestors checking outputs, before gaining one vote. A second identity run by the same operator faces a doubled workload plus a 14-day cooldown, and a third faces quadrupled tasks, so mass-producing fakes becomes a gale of wasted effort rather than cheap votes, while hollow accounts with no task history get zero weight and any identity caught sharing task proofs loses its stake and drops to the bottom tier.
